name: MilkyTracker
tagline: Fast Tracker II inspired music tracker
blurb: MilkyTracker is an open source, multi-platform music application for creating .MOD and .XM module files.
description:
MilkyTracker is an open source, multi-platform music application for creating .MOD and .XM
module files.
It attempts to recreate the module replay and user experience of the popular DOS program
Fasttracker II,
with special playback modes available for improved Amiga ProTracker 2/3 compatibility.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
